notes: Original SC TO-I with the Offer to Purchase dated February 22, 2021 for an unlisted closed-end fund (the filing says it is a closed-end management investment company whose Shares have no public market and that it makes quarterly repurchase offers), so fund_type is interval_or_tender_offer_fund; closed_end_fund is the alternative reading. Price is NAV per Share as of March 31, 2021 (the day after the March 30, 2021 expiration); price_pct_nav = 100 reads 'a price equal to the NAV per Share' as 100% of NAV, no percent is printed. Size: up to the LESSER of (i) 9,959,316 Shares (5% of the weighted average Shares outstanding for calendar 2020, not of current outstanding; 198,983,536 Shares outstanding as of February 11, 2021) and (ii) a DRIP-proceeds-based number not stated; size_shares and size_pct_outstanding give the stated cap (i). Commencement date not stated as a single date: the Offer to Purchase and the Schedule TO are dated February 22, 2021, but the shareholder letters (seq 4 and 5) say 'The Offer period will begin on or before March 1, 2021', so left null. Conditions (Section 3): violation of securities or other laws and material legal action (legal_injunction); banking moratorium, credit/foreign-exchange limitations, war or calamity (market_disruption); any other event that in the Board's judgment would have a material adverse effect (board_discretion). No minimum-tender condition (the offer states it is not conditioned on any minimum number of Shares); per-holder rule of tendering at least 25% or all Shares is not an offer condition category. The $7.4179 NAV per Share at January 31, 2021 is an example, not the purchase price, so final_price_per_share is null. No results fields: this is the commencement document. The excerpt ends inside the second shareholder letter (seq 5).
